intent.description: 一张静态的桌面照片，画面中明确可见两张白纸并置在桌面上；纸张为空白的、未写任何可识别文字、未印任何商标或来源标记；画面中不出现可识别的人物面部或手部；不出现任何屏幕、招牌、品牌包装或带印刷字的实物；整张图作为 0–15 秒全程保持不变的单一桌面画面。
intent.function: 作为 15 秒竖版静片的唯一视觉基底，用桌面与两张白纸承载后期间叠加的中文短句，本身不说明任何事、不暗示来源或经历。

constraints.preferred_visual_details: restrained low saturation, generous negative space, quiet everyday desk, soft natural light, no people, no logos, no screens, no printed text on objects

search_query_variants_en.alternate: minimalist desktop photo with two plain white sheets of paper
search_query_variants_en.primary: static desk still life two blank white papers overhead
search_query_variants_en.relaxed: everyday wooden desk surface with two empty white papers
